en.headline: 393 commits across 10 repos, 50 issues filed, 642 automated commits
en.teaser: A month of building OpenCode skill tooling: skill management, deep-research, translation and model-picker projects each shipped releases, alongside 50 issues filed upstream.
en.overview:
The window ran from 2026-10-03 to 2026-11-01 with data for every day. Totals were 393 own commits, 642 automated commits, 50 issues and no pull requests or reviews.

### Skill tooling and releases

Most of the work went into a family of OpenCode skills. `opencode-skill-management` grew from a first release candidate to a stable 1.0.0 and then 1.1.0 and 1.2.0, adding a `skill_management` plugin with list, inspect, disable and enable actions that write a single permission rule instead of touching skill files. Later versions moved all four actions to a single JSON object with a declared output schema, and fixed `list` reporting false divergence across hidden internal agents.

`meld-deepresearch` shipped 0.2.0, 0.3.0 and 0.4.0: explicit handling for blocked sources, validator hints on failure, a split into cooperating skills, and a thin `meld.py` CLI wrapping the gates. `opencode-go-model-picker` reached 1.3.0, 1.4.0, 2.0.0 and 3.0.0, adding agent-discovery and snapshot-summary scripts, shared JSON and proxy helpers, priced quota accounting, and a large text reduction.

### New projects and blog

`sopen-translate` was started from scratch as an MV3 extension with bilingual page rendering, chunk splitting, a circuit breaker, a provider protocol layer and glossary pipeline, then narrowed to page translation only with JSDoc type checking and smoke tests. `opencode-agent-sandbox` was initialized and filled with an archived knowledge base covering OpenCode V2 distribution, authentication and Windows path issues. `asset-inventory` corrected skill invocation facts across rules, samples and guides and released v1.15.4 and v1.15.5. `myBlog` received four OpenChamber capture screenshots.

### Daily report and upstream issues

The `sogeisetsu` profile repository carried the largest commit volume, building a daily GitHub activity report on Pages with rolling two-hour updates, manual date dispatch, inline code and bold support in AI summaries, dark-mode readability fixes and render regression tests. Upstream, 26 issues went to `openchamber/openchamber` covering storage management, MCP settings, session retention hints, quote cards, file-view commenting and context panel math, plus 12 to `anomalyco/opencode` on Windows CLI access and MiMo vision and subagent failures. Smaller reports went to `oh-my-opencode-slim`, `OfficeCLI` and two SenseNova repositories.

highlights.text: Released v1.0.0, freezing the skill_management surface for 1.x.
v0.4.0 introduced a thin meld.py CLI wrapping all six gate scripts.
3.0.0 simplified the skill to one entry point and one reference document.
Reported that Settings > MCP omits the Console MCP server OpenCode adds at runtime.
Filed a feature request for running the CLI shipped with the Windows desktop app.
Started an idea thread on commenting on selected code rather than line numbers.
Opened an issue on OpenCode V2 compatibility for SKILL.md frontmatter and runtime assumptions.

byRepo.text: 149 own commits plus 642 automated commits, 6 issues. Built the daily GitHub activity report: rolling two-hour updates, manual date dispatch, inline code and bold in AI summaries, dark-mode readability fixes, render regression tests and a fix to the test-render assertion collector.

61 own commits, 4 releases. Implemented the skill_management plugin with list, inspect, disable and enable, published release candidates and 1.0.0 through 1.2.0, moved actions to a JSON envelope with an output schema, and corrected plugin entry documentation.
58 own commits, 3 releases. Shipped 0.2.0, 0.3.0 and 0.4.0 with blocked-source rules, validator hints, cooperating skills, a meld.py CLI, genre templates and several Pages layout fixes.

56 own commits. Started the MV3 extension with bilingual page rendering, chunk splitting, a circuit breaker, provider protocol layer and glossary pipeline, then dropped selection translation and added JSDoc type checking and smoke tests.
38 own commits. Initialized the repository and built a knowledge base archiving OpenCode V2 distribution, architecture, authentication and Windows path findings, plus Git and GitHub notes.

26 issues. Reported bugs on storage management, MCP settings, session retention hints, quote cards, file-view commenting, context panel math, capture resolution and multi-run cleanup, and started several idea discussions.
21 own commits, 4 releases. Added agent-discovery and snapshot-summary scripts, shared atomic JSON and proxy helpers, priced quota accounting, version-drift checks and the 3.0.0 simplification.
12 issues. Reported Windows CLI access, MiMo vision reading stale images, subagent model_coming_soon failures, image input rejected by the Go endpoint and stale auth after removing auth.json.
6 own commits. Corrected skill invocation facts across the rule, samples, readmes and guides, fixed Japanese localization, and released v1.15.4 and v1.15.5.
4 own commits. Added four OpenChamber capture samples: desktop, panel region, mobile and a session retention hint screenshot.
2 issues. Reported that reflect --sessions queries legacy V1 tables and returns zero sessions on OpenCode V2.
2 issues. Reported that OpenCode detection and skill install paths point to ~/.opencode instead of ~/.config/opencode, and requested a v2 integration fix.
1 issue. Opened an issue on OpenCode V2 compatibility for SKILL.md frontmatter and runtime assumptions.
1 issue. Requested an extensible harness supporting OpenCode and Pi, and possible exposure as MCP.

zh.headline: 10 个仓库 393 次提交，提出 50 个 issue，另有 642 次自动提交
zh.teaser: 这个月主要围绕 OpenCode 技能工具展开：技能管理、深度研究、翻译和模型选择器项目各自发布了版本，同时向上游提交了 50 个 issue。
zh.overview:
本窗口为 2026-10-03 至 2026-11-01，每天都有数据。总计 393 次本人提交、642 次自动提交、50 个 issue，没有拉取请求和评审。

### 技能工具与发布

大部分工作集中在一组 OpenCode 技能上。`opencode-skill-management` 从首个候选版本走到稳定的 1.0.0，随后发布 1.1.0 和 1.2.0，实现 `skill_management` 插件的 list、inspect、disable、enable 四个动作，只写入一条权限规则而不改动技能文件。后续版本把四个动作统一为单个 JSON 对象并声明输出 schema，还修复了 `list` 对隐藏内部代理误报差异的问题。

`meld-deepresearch` 发布了 0.2.0、0.3.0 和 0.4.0：明确处理无法访问的来源、校验失败时给出修复提示、拆分为协作技能，并用轻量 `meld.py` 命令行封装各道关卡。`opencode-go-model-picker` 发布 1.3.0、1.4.0、2.0.0 和 3.0.0，新增代理发现与快照摘要脚本、共享的 JSON 与代理辅助模块、按价格计费的额度核算，并大幅精简文本。

### 新项目与博客

`sopen-translate` 从零开始搭建为 MV3 扩展，具备双语页面渲染、分块、熔断、提供方协议层和术语表流程，之后去掉划词翻译只保留页面翻译，并加入 JSDoc 类型检查和冒烟测试。`opencode-agent-sandbox` 完成初始化，并建立知识库，归档 OpenCode V2 的分发、架构、认证和 Windows 路径问题。`asset-inventory` 修正了规则、样例和指南中的技能调用说明，发布 v1.15.4 和 v1.15.5。`myBlog` 新增四张 OpenChamber 截图。

### 日报与上游 issue

`sogeisetsu` 个人仓库提交量最大，在 Pages 上搭建每日 GitHub 活动日报，支持每两小时滚动更新、手动指定日期、AI 摘要内联代码与加粗、深色模式可读性修复和渲染回归测试。上游方面，向 `openchamber/openchamber` 提交 26 个 issue，涉及存储管理、MCP 设置、会话保留提示、引用卡片、文件视图评论和上下文面板计算；向 `anomalyco/opencode` 提交 12 个，涉及 Windows 命令行入口以及 MiMo 视觉和子代理故障。另有少量 issue 提交给 `oh-my-opencode-slim`、`OfficeCLI` 和两个 SenseNova 仓库。

highlights.text: 发布 v1.0.0，将 skill_management 的接口在 1.x 内冻结。
v0.4.0 引入轻量 meld.py 命令行，封装全部六道关卡脚本。
3.0.0 将技能精简为一个入口和一个参考文档。
报告设置中的 MCP 页面遗漏了 OpenCode 运行时添加的 Console MCP 服务器。
提出功能请求：Windows 桌面版自带命令行却无法运行。
发起讨论，建议对选中的代码而非行号添加评论。
提出 OpenCode V2 兼容性问题，涉及 SKILL.md frontmatter 与运行时假设。

56 次本人提交。从零搭建 MV3 扩展，具备双语页面渲染、分块、熔断、提供方协议层和术语表流程，之后去掉划词翻译，并加入 JSDoc 类型检查和冒烟测试。
